outline:
先修課程：負責教授同意。物質熱力學特性、改變能量形式之基本原理、熱力學第一及第二定律、可逆性與可用性、動力循環、冷凍循環、混合氣、化學反應。
Prerequisite: Consent of Instructor
Thermodynamic Properties of Substance, Energy Forms, The First Law Thermodynamics, The Second Law of Thermodynamics, Irreversibility & Availability, Power Cycle, Refrigeration Systems, Mixtures, and Chemical Reactions.
schedule:
第1週 Introduction
第2週 Basic concepts of thermodynamics (I)
第3週 Basic concepts of thermodynamics (II)
第4週 Properties of pure substances (I)
第5週 Properties of pure substances (II)
第6週 Properties of pure substances (III)
第7週 Energy transfer by heat, work, and mass (I)
第8週 Energy transfer by heat, work, and mass (II)
第9週 The first law of thermodynamics (I)
第10週 期中考
第11週 The first law of thermodynamics (II)
第12週 The first law of thermodynamics (III)
第13週 The second law of thermodynamics (I)
第14週 The second law of thermodynamics (II)
第15週 Entropy (I)
第16週 Entropy (II)
第17週 Entropy (III)
第18週 期末考
scorePolicy:
